Why BlueMotion

Treatment that treats the cause — not just the pain

Every visit starts with a full assessment. We listen first, test how you move, explain what we find in plain words, and only then treat — so you always know what is happening and why.

Our Treatments

What we treat, and how we help

Clear prices, no surprises. Every treatment begins with a full assessment — and your first assessment is half price.

Back & Neck Pain

Slipped disc, sciatica, stiff neck or desk-posture pain — assessed, treated hands-on and strengthened for good.

$45 45 min Book

Sports Injuries

Sprains, strains, ACL and runner's knee — a return-to-sport plan with strength testing at every stage.

$55 60 min Book

Manual Therapy

Joint mobilisation, deep-tissue release and dry needling to ease pain and restore movement fast.

$50 45 min Book

Post-Surgery Rehab

Structured recovery after knee, hip or shoulder surgery — milestone-based, and shared with your surgeon.

$60 60 min Book
